decisions.briefing: Markets were roughly flat today (NASDAQ -0.4%, S&P 500 -0.1%), a neutral session with no major risk-on or risk-off signal. With 3 open slots and cash well above the deployment threshold, we added two high-conviction momentum names (SRAD, VSEC) that show full multi-signal confirmation while leaving existing winners untouched.

market_education.summary_en: Today's session was essentially flat, with the NASDAQ down 0.4% and the S&P 500 down 0.1%, reflecting a lack of strong directional catalysts. Without a clear risk-on or risk-off trigger, trading stayed range-bound as investors awaited fresh data. In this environment, stock-specific momentum signals matter more than broad index moves.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市表現大致平靜，納斯達克指數下跌0.4%，標普500指數則微跌0.1%，反映市場缺乏明顯的方向性催化劑。在沒有明確風險偏好或規避訊號的情況下，大市維持窄幅波動,投資者仍在等候新數據公佈。在這種環境下，個股的動能訊號比大盤走勢更具參考價值。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Multi-signal confirmation means only acting on a stock when several independent technical indicators — like RSI, MACD, price vs. moving average, and volume — all point the same direction. This reduces the chance of chasing a false signal, since one indicator alone can be noisy but several agreeing together suggests real conviction behind the move.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 多重訊號確認是指只有在多個獨立技術指標（例如RSI、MACD、股價與移動平均線的關係、成交量）同時指向同一方向時才採取行動。這樣可以減少被單一假訊號誤導的風險，因為單一指標可能只是噪音，但多個指標同時確認則顯示該走勢背後有真實的市場信念支持。
